spatial_role: Three public land fingers around water, buried urban streets open to estuary.
Stepped urban ridge, split living banks around diagonal canyon, distinct cross-city streets.
North-facing amphitheatre city, elevated ground shared with inner high city; underside loggias.
High inhabited basin, housing depth is its ground; 1100m public sky between non-identical city shores.
Uppermost tilted horizon: long urban trench, roof gardens and higher civic precinct at asymmetric western end.
Internal civic island, divides low public sky from upper diagonal sky, not a frontal gate.
